business_problem: Jiage Tiandi needed a scalable way to turn satellite remote sensing, IoT telemetry, weather data, and agricultural expertise into usable operational intelligence. Traditional local data-center deployments were not meeting requirements for secure storage, elastic performance, remote operations, or rapid delivery of crop-risk and production insights to customers.
solution_summary: Jiage Tiandi built its agricultural intelligence services on Alibaba Cloud to transform fragmented environmental data into production-ready AI applications. The company collects satellite remote-sensing imagery, IoT sensor signals, meteorological data, and agronomic knowledge, then fuses and analyzes them to produce spatial services for farmland protection, growth-cycle estimation, yield forecasting, disaster prediction, crop-protection advice, and harvest-timing recommendations. As customer scale grew, the team shifted core workloads to Alibaba Cloud ECS, RDS, and OSS so compute, databases, and data storage could be operated with stronger security, remote maintainability, and elastic scale than its previous local-machine-room model allowed. Jiage Tiandi also collaborated with Alibaba Cloud technical teams on visualization components and database work, which helped it extend the same data platform into land resources, emergency management, and financial-risk scenarios. The result is a cloud-native remote-sensing platform that makes agricultural decision support practical across widely distributed farmland.

solution_components.name: Elastic Compute Service (ECS)
solution_components.role: Runs Jiage Tiandi's remote-sensing analytics and application services with elastic compute capacity.

solution_components.name: ApsaraDB RDS
solution_components.role: Stores structured agricultural and operational data used by the spatiotemporal intelligence platform.

solution_components.name: Object Storage Service (OSS)
solution_components.role: Holds large remote-sensing and environmental datasets for downstream analysis and visualization.

data_flow: Satellite images, IoT telemetry, weather feeds, and agronomic data are collected into Jiage Tiandi's cloud platform, where they are fused, processed, and visualized on Alibaba Cloud infrastructure. The resulting predictions and recommendations are delivered to agricultural, land, emergency-management, and financial users for field planning and risk response.
business_outcome: Jiage Tiandi turned multi-source environmental data into a cloud service that can be delivered securely and maintained remotely across many customers. Alibaba Cloud lowered compute and storage costs, improved reliability and flexibility, and gave the company a base for expanding agricultural AI into adjacent land, emergency, and financial use cases.
architecture_clues: The platform combines satellite, IoT, and weather signals instead of relying on a single agricultural data source.
Cloud storage and databases are part of the production platform because remote-sensing workloads require both large object storage and structured serving layers.
Jiage Tiandi extends the same core intelligence stack beyond agriculture into land and financial scenarios.
